title: Lost applications after redeploy: container ran with persistence disabled
system: Tredgate Loan container pilot (gateway, loan-api, docs-search)

release.rollback_target: not used; configuration fixed in place

timezone: Europe/Prague (CEST, UTC+02:00); container logs are in UTC

impact.data_loss: 3 applications created 13:10-15:35 (loanIds mv9c2k1lzq8r4ta, mv9dt0f7hrx3n2w, mv9g8w3bq1pm7ye) lost at the 15:42 restart; re-entered 16:43-16:47 with new ids (mv9kq4d2xz7n1rb, mv9kr7m8vt3c5la, mv9ksx1h9fq2w6e)
impact.failed_decisions: 2 approvals returned 500 EACCES (13:25, 14:50); recorded 16:50 and 16:52 after the fix
impact.customer_impact_window_local: 13:00-16:40 (data at risk), 15:42-16:53 (applications missing from the list)
impact.personal_data: none in logs; applications re-entered from paper notes (POL-070 informed)

work_notes.author: Operations Lead
work_notes.note: Officer report: approval fails with EACCES on /data/audit.log; creating works. Not escalated.

work_notes.author: Operations Lead
work_notes.note: Second approval failure with the same text.

work_notes.author: Operations Lead
work_notes.note: Total Applications tile 6 instead of 9; only seed records listed.

work_notes.author: Release Engineer
work_notes.note: /data on host: loans.json dated Monday with 9 records, root-owned; audit.log absent; container user is node.

work_notes.author: Platform Engineer on-call
work_notes.note: loan-api boot at 13:00 and at 15:42 both log level 40 'persistence disabled' reason 'EACCES /data/loans.json' (REF-030).

work_notes.author: Platform Engineer on-call
work_notes.note: Cause confirmed: non-root container user, root-owned bind mount. Data file intact; RB-003 restore not needed.

work_notes.author: Platform Engineering Lead
work_notes.note: Fix approved: chown data folder, named volume, image prepares /data.

work_notes.author: Release Engineer
work_notes.note: Container recreated with the fix; boot without 'persistence disabled'; 9 records listed.

work_notes.author: Operations Lead
work_notes.note: 3 applications re-entered, 2 approvals recorded (decision audited). Tile 12.

work_notes.author: Operations Lead
work_notes.note: Resolved message sent. Postmortem due 2026-10-14, KI-006.

related.known_issue: KI-006 (to be filed with the postmortem)
